title: Como tener RITMO para BAILAR - Musicalidad parte 1| Yopi Quintero

method.teacher_system: The teacher first explains the structure of rhythm by breaking down music into beats, measures, and phrases. Then he demonstrates counting exercises and plays audio examples to help the learner identify phrase changes.

practices.what: Demonstrates a bit as a pulsation marking the tempo by tapping his hand.
Counts out loud and claps to show a 2-bit compas accented on one.
Counts and claps to show a 3-bit compas accented on one.
Counts and claps to show a 4-bit compas accented on one.
Counts out loud from one to sixteen to demonstrate a musical phrase.
Counts along to a playing song from one to sixteen, marking the phrase change.

beliefs.belief: There are specific exercises and techniques that help learners find rhythm when dancing.
There are two reasons people lack rhythm: undeveloped musical ear or lack of knowledge about music.

moments.says: The teacher introduces himself and explains that the lesson is about finding rhythm when dancing.
The teacher tells the learner not to panic or despair because he is going to explain everything step by step.

struggles.theme: Always dancing out of time or off beat
Difficulty understanding musical timing and counting

clicked.theme: Finally understanding musical time and beat changes

requests.theme: More salsa and bachata tutorials and examples

meant.theme: Saved from wanting to quit dancing and finally making progress

method.limits: The video only covers theoretical musicality without physical footwork instruction.
